invented.quote: But that means a quarter of new sales went to replacing lost revenue instead of growing.
invented.why: Since the brief shows that monthly recurring revenue stayed flat at $41,000, 100% of new sales revenue went to replacing lost revenue, not a quarter of it (unless the writer meant "a quarter's worth of new sales," which is not supported as a fraction of sales).

invented.quote: When a clinic's records system comes with a scheduler, that scheduler is already paid for and usually good enough
invented.why: The brief does not state whether schedulers built into electronic records systems are already paid for (versus costing extra) or whether they are usually good enough.
